fields.name: CLIENT_ID_DOC
fields.value: An id string to pass to the server when making requests. The purpose of this is to be able to track the source of requests beyond just ip/port by allowing a logical application name to be included in server-side request logging.

fields.name: CLIENT_RACK_DOC
fields.value: A rack identifier for this client. This can be any string value which indicates where this client is physically located. It corresponds with the broker config 'broker.rack'

fields.name: CONNECTIONS_MAX_IDLE_MS_DOC
fields.value: Close idle connections after the number of milliseconds specified by this config.

fields.name: ENABLE_METRICS_PUSH_DOC
fields.value: Whether to enable pushing of client metrics to the cluster, if the cluster has a client metrics subscription which matches this client.

fields.name: GROUP_ID_DOC
fields.value: A unique string that identifies the consumer group this consumer belongs to. This property is required if the consumer uses either the group management functionality by using subscribe(topic) or the Kafka-based offset management strategy.

fields.name: METADATA_MAX_AGE_DOC
fields.value: The period of time in milliseconds after which we force a refresh of metadata even if we haven't seen any partition leadership changes to proactively discover any new brokers or partitions.

fields.name: METRICS_NUM_SAMPLES_DOC
fields.value: The number of samples maintained to compute metrics.

fields.name: METRICS_SAMPLE_WINDOW_MS_DOC
fields.value: The window of time a metrics sample is computed over.

fields.name: RECEIVE_BUFFER_DOC
fields.value: The size of the TCP receive buffer (SO_RCVBUF) to use when reading data. If the value is -1, the OS default will be used.

fields.name: SECURITY_PROTOCOL_DOC
fields.value: Protocol used to communicate with brokers.

fields.name: SEND_BUFFER_DOC
fields.value: The size of the TCP send buffer (SO_SNDBUF) to use when sending data. If the value is -1, the OS default will be used.

overloads.name: CommitFailedException
overloads.fixed_message: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced and assigned the partitions to another member. This means that the time between subsequent calls to poll() was longer than the configured max.poll.interval.ms, which typically implies that the poll loop is spending too much time message processing. You can address this either by increasing max.poll.interval.ms or by reducing the maximum size of batches returned in poll() with max.poll.records.

fields.name: KEY_DESERIALIZER_CLASS_DOC
fields.value: Deserializer class for key that implements the org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Deserializer interface.

fields.name: VALUE_DESERIALIZER_CLASS_DOC
fields.value: Deserializer class for value that implements the org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Deserializer interface.

overloads.name: NoOffsetForPartitionException
overloads.fixed_message: Undefined offset with no reset policy for partition:

overloads.name: NoOffsetForPartitionException
overloads.fixed_message: Undefined offset with no reset policy for partitions:

overloads.name: RetriableCommitFailedException
overloads.fixed_message: Offset commit failed with a retriable exception. You should retry committing the latest consumed offsets.

fields.name: KEY_SERIALIZER_CLASS_DOC
fields.value: Serializer class for key that implements the org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serializer interface.

fields.name: VALUE_SERIALIZER_CLASS_DOC
fields.value: Serializer class for value that implements the org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serializer interface.

fields.name: SASL_KERBEROS_MIN_TIME_BEFORE_RELOGIN_DOC
fields.value: Login thread sleep time between refresh attempts.

fields.name: SASL_KERBEROS_TICKET_RENEW_JITTER_DOC
fields.value: Percentage of random jitter added to the renewal time.

fields.name: SASL_MECHANISM_DOC
fields.value: SASL mechanism used for client connections. This may be any mechanism for which a security provider is available. GSSAPI is the default mechanism.

fields.name: SSL_ENDPOINT_IDENTIFICATION_ALGORITHM_DOC
fields.value: The endpoint identification algorithm to validate server hostname using server certificate.

fields.name: SSL_PROVIDER_DOC
fields.value: The name of the security provider used for SSL connections. Default value is the default security provider of the JVM.

fields.name: SSL_SECURE_RANDOM_IMPLEMENTATION_DOC
fields.value: The SecureRandom PRNG implementation to use for SSL cryptography operations.

fields.name: SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION_DOC
fields.value: The location of the trust store file.

fields.name: SSL_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE_DOC
fields.value: The file format of the trust store file. The values currently supported by the default ssl.engine.factory.class are [JKS, PKCS12, PEM].

fields.name: MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES_DOC
fields.value: The largest record batch size allowed by Kafka (after compression if compression is enabled).

fields.name: SASL_MECHANISM_INTER_BROKER_PROTOCOL_DOC
fields.value: SASL mechanism used for inter-broker communication. Default is GSSAPI.

overloads.name: CorruptRecordException
overloads.fixed_message: This message has failed its CRC checksum, exceeds the valid size, has a null key for a compacted topic, or is otherwise corrupt.

overloads.name: TransactionAbortedException
overloads.fixed_message: Failing batch since transaction was aborted
